text:
sre-oncall: Heads up — dedicated capacity dashboard shows 0 GPUs for cluster starlight-prod after last night's scaling job. UI /per-cluster view is empty.

maria: I saw alerts about failed reconciler jobs at ~01:03 UTC. Could be related.

ken: Can you paste the API response from inventory? run: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://internal-api.redwood/v1/clusters/starlight-prod/nodes`

maria: response snip: ```{"nodes":[], "last_synced":"2026-03-03T01:02:58Z"}``` so the inventory service thinks there are no nodes. but the k8s cluster clearly has GPUs.

ashley: checking kube: `kubectl get nodes -l redwood/cluster=starlight-prod -o wide` returns 6 nodes with label `gpu=true` and allocatable GPUs 8 each.

platform-eng: Monitoring shows metrics coming from those nodes to prometheus (node-exporter), so scraping OK. Problem seems to be the inventory indexer not finding the cluster after the node-label change we pushed in the rolling update.

ken: FYI the rolling update yesterday changed the cluster id label from `cluster=starlight` to `redwood/cluster=starlight-prod` (per infra PR #452). Looks like the reconciler wasn't updated to accept the new key.

sre-oncall: That would explain it. Do we have a quick remediation?

maria: Workaround: re-run the inventory sync job to rebuild the cache: `kubectl -n platform-job run sync-inventory --image=redwood/inventory-sync:prod --restart=OnFailure -- /sync --cluster starlight-prod` — I kicked it off, job started.

monitoring-bot: Job sync-inventory started (job/sync-inventory) — logs will stream to /var/logs/jobs.

ashley: logs show: `WARN reconciler: unknown cluster label key: cluster` then `INFO reconciler: matched cluster redwood/cluster=starlight-prod`. The job retried a few times and then repopulated index.

platform-eng: After job completion UI is showing correct GPU counts again. But we need a permanent fix: update reconciler to accept both legacy and new label keys, and add an Alert if inventory index falls to 0 while prometheus shows >0 node exporters.

ken: Filing follow-up tasks: ENG-PLATFORM-1294 — reconciler support both labels + add watch on label changes; ENG-SRE-2108 — alert for inventory/prom mismatch; I'll include repro steps and logs.

maria: Repro steps I used: 1) patch nodes to remove old `cluster` label and add `redwood/cluster=starlight-prod` on a canary node 2) run inventory-sync job 3) observe UI reflect counts. Logs attached to ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployed reconciliation patch to staging at 2026-03-03T08:15:00Z (release/infra 2.1.7).

ashley: 👍 recommend backport to prod ASAP, and add a migration script to re-label older nodes for consistency.

sre-oncall: Thanks team — monitoring alert suppressed now that index is rebuilt. I'll monitor for 2 hours then close this thread. :thumbsup:
